description:
A high-performance, system level engine for recording, editing and playing back keyboard macros.
Includes stealth recording, a multi-event editor, custom shortcuts and adjustable playback speed.

This add-on is based on NVDA Macro Manager by Muhammet Enes Şenovalı. It is published as a separate add-on so that development can continue actively.
changelog:
1.0.1

Fixed chords being flattened. When two keys overlapped, the release of the first was injected in the same
system call as the press of the second, so the two were never held down at the same moment and the target
application saw two unrelated keystrokes instead of the combination. Presses now only ever travel with
presses and releases with releases.
Raising the playback speed no longer shrinks the overlap between two keys to nothing; keys held together
now stay together for at least the configured minimum hold time.

1.0

First release of Macro Studio.

Macro Studio continues the work of NVDA Macro Manager by Muhammet Enes Şenovalı as a separate add-on, so that
development can carry on actively. The keyboard engine of the original add-on was rewritten and a large number
of defects were fixed before this release.

Playback engine:
Keys that were pressed together are now replayed together. A whole chord is injected with a single system call
instead of one key after another, and overlapping or held keys keep their original order and timing.
Keys chosen from the key list now carry their real scan code and extended flag, so arrows, Insert, Delete,
Home, End, right Ctrl, right Alt and numpad divide no longer arrive as a different key.
Fixed the key list replacing standard letters with layout specific keys, which could send a completely
different key than the one selected.
Fixed partially rejected keystroke batches being resent in full, which produced duplicate keystrokes.
Fixed a race that allowed the same macro to start twice and interleave its keystrokes.
Fixed a hold time floor that was applied to every key release and pulled apart keys released together.
Fixed the application lock being bypassed when the foreground application could not be identified.

Recording:
Fixed a recording that repeated a single key being erased by the stop hotkey trimming.
Fixed key events that are not real key transitions being stored and then silently dropped on playback.
Recording can no longer be started while a macro is playing, and a failed keyboard hook is now reported.

Macros and interface:
Fixed macros saved from the dialog being locked to NVDA itself instead of the target application.
Fixed the smart loop optimiser dropping most repetitions of macros with a loop count above one.
Fixed duplicated macros sharing an identifier, which made one of them impossible to assign a gesture to.
Fixed the macro list keeping a hidden extra selection, so deleting could remove the wrong macro.
Fixed hold-to-run, which failed on every hotkey and could stop itself on its own keystrokes.
Fixed an empty playback speed field aborting the save.
Fixed all playback messages failing silently because a loop variable shadowed the translation function.
Export file names are now sanitised and the clipboard import is size limited.
The dark dialog colours are only applied when Windows itself is in dark mode.
Keyboard hooks are released when the add-on is unloaded.

Translations:
Complete translations for Arabic, Azerbaijani, Chinese (simplified and traditional), Dutch, English, Filipino,
German, Hindi, Kurdish (Kurmanji and Sorani), Portuguese (Brazil and Portugal), Russian, Spanish, Turkish and
Vietnamese. The German and Spanish catalogues of the original add-on were keyed to obsolete source strings and
never actually applied.

translations.description:
Um mecanismo de alto desempenho, em nível de sistema, para gravar, editar e reproduzir macros de teclado.
Inclui gravação segura, editor de vários eventos, atalhos personalizados e velocidade de reprodução ajustável.

Este complemento é baseado no NVDA Macro Manager de Muhammet Enes Şenovalı. Ele é publicado como um complemento separado para que o desenvolvimento possa continuar de forma ativa.

一个高性能的系统级引擎，用于录制、编辑和播放键盘宏。
包含安全录制、多事件编辑器、自定义快捷键和可调播放速度。

本插件基于 Muhammet Enes Şenovalı 的 NVDA Macro Manager 开发，并作为独立插件发布，以便持续积极地开发。

A high-performance, system level engine for recording, editing and playing back keyboard macros.
Includes stealth recording, a multi-event editor, custom shortcuts and adjustable playback speed.

This add-on is based on NVDA Macro Manager by Muhammet Enes Şenovalı. It is published as a separate add-on so that development can continue actively.

Motoreke bilez a asta pergalê ji bo tomarkirin, guherandin û lêxistina makroyên klavyeyê.
Tomarkirina ewle, guherînerê gelek bûyeran, kurterêyên taybet û leza lêxistinê ya guherbar dihewîne.

Ev pêvek li ser bingeha NVDA Macro Manager a Muhammet Enes Şenovalı hatiye amadekirin. Ji bo ku pêşxistin bi awayekî çalak bidome, wek pêvekeke cuda hatiye weşandin.

Высокопроизводительный движок системного уровня для записи, редактирования и воспроизведения клавиатурных макросов.
Включает безопасную запись, редактор событий, собственные сочетания клавиш и настраиваемую скорость воспроизведения.

Это дополнение основано на NVDA Macro Manager от Muhammet Enes Şenovalı. Оно публикуется как отдельное дополнение, чтобы разработку можно было продолжать активно.

कीबोर्ड मैक्रो को रिकॉर्ड करने, संपादित करने और चलाने के लिए तेज़, सिस्टम स्तर का इंजन।
इसमें सुरक्षित रिकॉर्डिंग, अनेक घटनाओं का संपादक, अपने शॉर्टकट और बदली जा सकने वाली गति शामिल है।

यह ऐड-ऑन Muhammet Enes Şenovalı के NVDA Macro Manager पर आधारित है। विकास को सक्रिय रूप से जारी रखने के लिए इसे एक अलग ऐड-ऑन के रूप में प्रकाशित किया गया है।

Eine leistungsstarke Engine auf Systemebene zum Aufzeichnen, Bearbeiten und Abspielen von Tastaturmakros.
Mit sicherer Aufzeichnung, einem Editor für mehrere Ereignisse, eigenen Tastenkombinationen und einstellbarer Wiedergabegeschwindigkeit.

Diese Erweiterung basiert auf NVDA Macro Manager von Muhammet Enes Şenovalı. Sie wird als eigenständige Erweiterung veröffentlicht, damit die Entwicklung aktiv fortgesetzt werden kann.

Um motor de alto desempenho, em nível de sistema, para gravar, editar e reproduzir macros de teclado.
Inclui gravação segura, editor de vários eventos, atalhos personalizados e velocidade de reprodução ajustável.

Este extra baseia-se no NVDA Macro Manager de Muhammet Enes Şenovalı. É publicado como um extra separado para que o desenvolvimento possa continuar de forma ativa.

بزوێنەرێکی خێرا لە ئاستی سیستەم بۆ تۆمارکردن، دەستکاری و لێدانی ماکرۆکانی تەختەکلیل.
تۆمارکردنی پارێزراو، دەستکاریکەری چەند ڕووداو، کورتەڕێی تایبەت و خێرایی گۆڕاوی لێدان لەخۆدەگرێت.

ئەم پێوەکراوە لەسەر بنەمای NVDA Macro Manager ی Muhammet Enes Şenovalı دروستکراوە. وەک پێوەکراوێکی جیاواز بڵاوکراوەتەوە بۆ ئەوەی گەشەپێدان بە چالاکی بەردەوام بێت.

محرك عالي الأداء على مستوى النظام لتسجيل وحدات ماكرو لوحة المفاتيح وتحريرها وتشغيلها.
يتضمن التسجيل الآمن، ومحرر أحداث متعددة، واختصارات مخصصة، وسرعة تشغيل قابلة للضبط.

هذه الإضافة مبنية على NVDA Macro Manager من إعداد Muhammet Enes Şenovalı. وقد نُشرت كإضافة منفصلة لكي يستمر تطويرها بنشاط.

Một công cụ hiệu năng cao ở mức hệ thống để ghi, chỉnh sửa và phát lại macro bàn phím.
Bao gồm chế độ ghi an toàn, trình chỉnh sửa nhiều sự kiện, phím tắt tùy chỉnh và tốc độ phát điều chỉnh được.

Tiện ích này được xây dựng dựa trên NVDA Macro Manager của Muhammet Enes Şenovalı. Nó được phát hành thành một tiện ích riêng để việc phát triển có thể tiếp tục một cách tích cực.

Un motor de alto rendimiento, a nivel del sistema, para grabar, editar y reproducir macros de teclado.
Incluye grabación segura, un editor de varios eventos, atajos personalizados y velocidad de reproducción ajustable.

Este complemento se basa en NVDA Macro Manager de Muhammet Enes Şenovalı. Se publica como un complemento independiente para que el desarrollo pueda continuar de forma activa.

Klaviatura makrolarını yazmaq, redaktə etmək və oxutmaq üçün yüksək məhsuldarlıqlı, sistem səviyyəli mühərrik.
Təhlükəsiz yazma, çoxhadisəli redaktor, fərdi qısayollar və tənzimlənən oxutma sürəti daxildir.

Bu əlavə Muhammet Enes Şenovalı-nin NVDA Macro Manager əlavəsi əsasında hazırlanıb. İnkişafın fəal şəkildə davam etdirilməsi üçün ayrıca əlavə kimi dərc olunub.

Een snelle engine op systeemniveau om toetsenbordmacro's op te nemen, te bewerken en af te spelen.
Met veilige opname, een editor voor meerdere gebeurtenissen, eigen sneltoetsen en instelbare afspeelsnelheid.

Deze add-on is gebaseerd op NVDA Macro Manager van Muhammet Enes Şenovalı. Hij wordt als aparte add-on uitgebracht zodat de ontwikkeling actief kan doorgaan.

一個高效能的系統層級引擎，用來錄製、編輯與播放鍵盤巨集。
包含安全錄製、多事件編輯器、自訂快速鍵與可調整的播放速度。

本附加元件以 Muhammet Enes Şenovalı 的 NVDA Macro Manager 為基礎，並以獨立的附加元件發布，以便持續積極開發。

Isang mabilis at antas-sistemang makina para mag-record, mag-edit at magpatugtog ng mga macro sa keyboard.
Kasama ang ligtas na pagre-record, editor ng maraming kaganapan, sariling shortcut at nababagong bilis ng pagpapatugtog.

Nakabatay ang add-on na ito sa NVDA Macro Manager ni Muhammet Enes Şenovalı. Inilalabas ito bilang hiwalay na add-on upang maipagpatuloy nang aktibo ang pagpapaunlad.

Klavye makrolarını kaydeden, düzenleyen ve oynatan yüksek başarımlı, sistem düzeyinde bir motor.
Gizli kayıt kipi, çok olaylı makro düzenleyici, özel kısayollar ve ayarlanabilir oynatma hızı içerir.

Bu eklenti, Muhammet Enes Şenovalı'nın NVDA Macro Manager eklentisi temel alınarak hazırlanmıştır. Geliştirmenin etkin biçimde sürdürülebilmesi için ayrı bir eklenti olarak yayımlanmıştır.
